**Chinese name:** 紫光国芯微电子股份有限公司 (Zǐguāng Guówēi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's specialty-IC national champion — the chip backbone of defense/avionics — and the profitable exception among design houses: FY2025 revenue ¥61.46亿 (+11.5%), net ¥14.37亿 at 55.6% gross margin; H1 2026 net ¥7.98亿. January 2026: agreed to buy power-semi maker 瑞能半导体 (NXP/WeEn lineage) for ¥1.9 billion, extending the portfolio into power discretes.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Radiation/aerospace-tolerant CPUs/FPGA/memory/analog, eSIM and secure-element chips, quartz timing devices.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | State-Backed Design House |
| **Founded** | 2001 |
| **Location** | Beijing, Beijing Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Specialty (mil/aerospace-grade) ICs — >60% domestic share in special FPGA, 800+ part numbers; smart- security chips (eSIM/SIM global leader, car security); quartz devices |
| **Node Sophistication** | Aerospace-grade qualification over geometry; 宇航用FPGA family + specialty HBM in customer test (2025); AI video chip completed |
| **Entity List** | No |
